page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 192 dedicated physical cores and 192 vCPUs, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated allocation of 192 physical cores with a 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio offers high compute density for parallel processing workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading. This hardware profile is suited for compute-intensive workloads, high-performance computing, large-scale batch processing, and highly parallelized simulation tasks that require substantial CPU resources but do not demand high memory-to-CPU ratios.
